description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
Sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing time with Maria!

Would you like help turning that into an email? I can draft or send one for you. Below are three quick templates you can use — tell me which to send or if you want changes.

1) Quick note to friends
Subject: Weekend in the countryside
Body:
Hi everyone —  
I spent the weekend in the countryside with my sister Maria. We explored some beautiful nature trails, breathed in a lot of fresh air, and had a really relaxing time. I’ve attached a few photos — it felt great to unplug for a bit. Hope you’re all well!

2) Message to parents
Subject: Short weekend getaway
Body:
Hi Mom and Dad —  
Just wanted to share that Maria and I took a short trip to the countryside this weekend. We walked several nature trails, enjoyed the quiet and fresh air, and it was so refreshing. We’re back now and doing well. I’ll send photos soon!

3) Thank-you note to Maria
Subject: Thanks for a lovely weekend
Body:
Hey Maria —  
Thanks for the lovely weekend — I really enjoyed exploring the trails and just getting away. It was so nice to relax together. Let’s plan another trip soon!

Tell me:
- Which template to use (1, 2, or 3), or ask for edits
- Who to send it to (email address), and whether to send now or save as a draft
- If you want to include photos or a more detailed write-up

I’ll draft/send it as you prefer.
